title: hieracium pilosella var. peleteriana
intro: Hieracium pilosella var. peleteriana, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the dandelion family. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, pain, and digestive problems. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating wounds, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
